name: Metal dragons

unlocks.name: Pedal to the Metals
unlocks.notes: Increases the number of metal dragons assigned to 150-200.

unlocks.name: Duly Noted
unlocks.notes: Mithril dragons drop mithril bars in banknote form while killed on assignment.

requiredItemName: anti-dragon shield or super antifire potion

variantInfo.name: Bronze dragon
notes: Weakest variant of metal dragons.
Weakest variant of metal dragons and does not drop the draconic visage.
Use melee range and Protect from Melee if fought without complete dragonfire protection.

variantInfo.name: Bronze dragon
notes: Catacombs of Kourend version of Bronze dragon.
Stronger combat level than the Brimhaven version.
Uses the Catacombs drop table.

variantInfo.name: Iron dragon
notes: Second weakest variant of metal dragons.
Can be cannoned when seeking the draconic visage.
Still relatively easy to kill compared with higher metal dragons.

variantInfo.name: Iron dragon
notes: Catacombs of Kourend version of Iron dragon.
Stronger than the standard level 189 Iron dragon.
Can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

variantInfo.name: Steel dragon
notes: Third weakest variant of metal dragons.
Cannonable in Brimhaven Dungeon.
Often killed only for collection log or location requirements.

variantInfo.name: Steel dragon
notes: Catacombs of Kourend version of Steel dragon.
Stronger than the standard level 246 Steel dragon.
Uses the Catacombs drop table.

variantInfo.name: Mithril dragon
notes: Requires completion of the first part of Barbarian Firemaking to access the Ancient Cavern.
Uses all three forms of combat.
Exclusively drops the dragon full helm and chewed bones as a second roll option.

variantInfo.name: Adamant dragon
notes: Requires completion of Dragon Slayer II.
Uses all three forms of combat.
Has a Ruby bolts style ranged special that ignores prayer.
Has a poison projectile special that is reduced by antipoison protection.
Drops dragon limbs and the exclusive dragon metal slice.

variantInfo.name: Rune dragon
notes: Requires completion of Dragon Slayer II.
Uses all three forms of combat.
Has an onyx bolt style ranged special that heals the dragon for damage dealt.
Can throw two lightning bolts; insulated boots reduce this damage.
Drops dragon limbs and the exclusive dragon metal lump.

locationComparison.name: Brimhaven Dungeon (task only area)
notes: 5 bronze, 9 iron, and 9 steel dragons.
An axe is needed if entering via the north entrance, requiring 10 Woodcutting.
875 coins entry each time, a one-time 1,000,000 coin fee, or one-off 5000 trading sticks alternate entry.
Fairy ring code CKR then north to the dungeon.
Elite Karamja Diary allows noted bar drops to be toggled through Pirate Jackie the Fruit.

locationComparison.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: 3 bronze, 13 iron, and 4 steel dragons.
An axe is needed if entering via the north entrance, requiring 10 Woodcutting.
875 coins entry each time, a one-time 1,000,000 coin fee, or one-off 5000 trading sticks alternate entry.
Fairy ring code CKR then north to the dungeon.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: 5 bronze, 2 iron, and 2 steel dragons.
Monsters in the Catacombs of Kourend are stronger than their normal counterparts.
Drops Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
Fastest route is Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart or Kourend Castle Teleport after Client of Kourend.

locationComparison.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: 3 iron dragons.
Cannonable single-combat option for Iron dragons.

locationComparison.name: Ancient Cavern (upper level)
notes: 7 mithril dragons.
The cavern can only be accessed after completing the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring 35 Firemaking.
Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost and run south to quickly reach the dragons.

locationComparison.name: Lithkren Vault
notes: 5 adamant and 5 rune dragons.
Only accessible after completion of Dragon Slayer II.

taskNotes: Metal dragons can be assigned by high-level Slayer masters as a potential task.
Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I is required.
Bronze dragons are found in Brimhaven Dungeon and the Catacombs of Kourend and are the lowest level option.
Iron dragons are found in the same locations as bronze dragons, are more plentiful, and can also be found in the Isle of Souls Dungeon.
Steel dragons are found in Brimhaven Dungeon and the Catacombs of Kourend.
Mithril dragons are found in the Ancient Cavern, requiring the first part of Barbarian Firemaking.
Adamant dragons and rune dragons are found in Lithkren Vault and require Dragon Slayer II.
Of these dragons, only mithril dragons cannot be cannoned.
All metal dragons can use melee and long range dragonfire, which rolls differently from chromatic dragonfire.
Unlike chromatic dragons, metal dragons aren't affected by Protect from Magic against dragonfire.
An anti-dragon shield is mandatory if not using a super antifire potion.
Mithril, adamant and rune dragons can use both magic and ranged attacks.
Adamant and rune dragons have special ranged attacks that mimic ruby and onyx enchanted bolts respectively.
All metal dragons have the draconic attribute and are susceptible to dragon hunter lance, dragon hunter crossbow, and dragon hunter wand.
Metal dragons are weakest to stab and heavy ranged attacks, although higher level metal dragons resist heavy ranged more.
All metal dragons have a 50% vulnerability to earth spells.
For a fast task, kill bronze dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon's slayer-only area where five are in a small cannonable area.
iron dragons may be cannoned if seeking the draconic visage, as bronze dragons do not drop it.
For profit, kill rune dragons instead.
Other metal dragons are generally not recommended except for collection log purposes.
Metal dragons have an incredibly high weight as a Slayer task, so players should decide whether to block them based on the tasks they want.
recommendedMethod: For speed, cannon bronze dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon's task-only area. Cannon iron dragons if chasing draconic visage, use rune dragons for profit, and bring full dragonfire protection plus dragonbane, stab, heavy ranged, or earth spell setups.
